pageHeader.title: asset template
pageHeader.description: maintain asset templates and their associated processing handlers.

info.title: What is an Asset Template?
info.description: An Asset Template is a reusable blueprint that onboards a device type by configuration instead of code. It defines the device classification, where to find the device id in each payload (assetIdPath), the transform scripts that turn raw payloads into normalized events, and the EVA schema of dynamic fields the device reports. One template serves thousands of assets of the same type.

reusability.title: Reusable Blueprint
reusability.text: One template serves thousands of assets of the same type — a new vendor or model is a configuration, never a new code branch

processing.title: Transform Scripts
processing.text: A validator and a conversion script are required; a preprocessor and a test script are optional — together they turn raw device payloads into normalized events

manufacturer.title: Device Classification
manufacturer.text: Category, manufacturer, model, and version identify the device, and the assetIdPath locates its id inside each incoming payload

systemTemplates.title: System Templates
systemTemplates.text: Ready-made templates MapexOS ships for common device types and protocols

customization.title: Custom Templates
customization.text: Build your own template — its dynamic EVA fields and transform scripts — tailored to your device's data format
